What remains in this bucket is StartupMiddleware and preference plumbing, so the original Occurrence of 7 overstated it.

severity-ip-protection.rationale: Confirmed. A silent IP Protection failure tells the user they are protected when they are not, which is a trust violation rather than a broken feature.
